items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: I got a job going at Tom Anderson in 1922.

ctx.x: What did you do when the fight stopped? When the fight stopped?

Just get out the way, move out the way. Try and protect my drums and get out the way. Well, they never bothered us. I mean, they'd be fighting amongst themselves. But they was good people, though. They were really nice. I played a lot of jobs up there with Kid Punch's band, Irish Channel. Kid Punch had so much work. At that time, I had to carry my drums, you know, from down here and all the way up to the Irish Channel. You see, you wouldn't lie on a street car. Or you'd catch a ride, somebody, you know, with a…
When did Chani play with Punch? Before you or after?
